error.conn_hint: Could not connect to the debug port. On your phone's Wireless debugging main screen (not the pairing popup), read the port under "IP address & Port" and enter it in the Debug port field, then retry.
error.device_offline: Device paired but offline. Keep the phone's screen on, confirm "IP address & Port" on the Wireless debugging main screen, enter that port in the Debug port field and retry.
error.pick_in_progress: A file picker is already open

notify.retry_exhausted: Failed to connect to {name} after 3 retries. Please confirm the phone is online.
notify.uninstalled: Plugin uninstalled. Close any running scrcpy windows manually.

panel.adb_hint: ADB device — cast from the action panel.
panel.cast_offline_hint: Device is not reachable by adb. Check the USB cable / wireless debugging, then retry.
panel.empty: No devices found. Pair a device in KDE Connect.
panel.pair_first_hint: On your phone's Wireless debugging main screen: the debug port is under "IP address & Port". If you can't find it, leave it at 5555 — the plugin will also try 5555 and the pairing port automatically. The pairing port + 6-digit code are in "Pair device with pairing code".
panel.pair_hint: The **pairing port** is one-time — used by `adb pair` with the 6-digit code. The **debug port** is for long-term `adb connect` / scrcpy. After pairing, use the debug port to connect.
panel.pair_missing: Enter both the pairing port and code first.
panel.params_hint: Applies to the selected device only
panel.record_desc: Record the mirror to a file

battery_display.description: Choose whether the bar widget shows the battery icon, percentage, both, or neither.
battery_display.label: Battery Display

bit_rate.description: Video stream bitrate in megabits per second.
bit_rate.label: Bitrate (Mbps)

enable_charging_animation.description: Highlight the bar widget when the device is charging.
enable_charging_animation.label: Show Charging Fill

enable_clipboard_action.description: Show a quick action to send the clipboard to the device.
enable_clipboard_action.label: Show Clipboard Action

max_size.description: Limit the long edge of the video stream (pixels).
max_size.label: Max Resolution

migrated.description: Edit these directly in the panel: click the device's avatar to change its image, click its name to rename it. Per-device and saved automatically.
migrated.label: Device image and name

panel_placement.description: How the details panel opens: attached to the bar, or floating.
panel_placement.label: Panel Placement

poll_interval.description: How often to scan for devices.
poll_interval.label: Poll Interval (ms)

record.description: Record the screen to a file.
record.label: Record

record_max_files.description: Maximum number of recording files to keep. Oldest are deleted.
record_max_files.label: Max Recordings

show_device_name.description: Show the selected device's name or alias in the bar widget.
show_device_name.label: Show Device Name

state_update_interval.description: Seconds between automatic device state refreshes. 0 disables auto-refresh.
state_update_interval.label: State Update Interval

turn_screen_off.description: Turn off the phone screen while mirroring.
turn_screen_off.label: Turn Screen Off
